title: Pride and Prejudice
description: The story follows the main character Elizabeth Bennet as she deals with issues of manners, upbringing, morality, education, and marriage in the society of the landed gentry of early 19th-century England.

title: Sense and Sensibility
description: The story follows the Dashwood sisters, Elinor and Marianne, as they come of age and experience love and heartbreak for the first time.

title: Emma
description: The story follows Emma Woodhouse, a young woman who fancies herself a matchmaker in her small town, as she navigates romance and relationships.

title: Mansfield Park
description: The story follows Fanny Price, a young woman who is sent to live with her wealthy aunt and uncle at their estate, Mansfield Park.

title: Persuasion
description: The story follows Anne Elliot, who, at 27, is on the verge of spinsterhood when her former fiancé returns to her life after eight years.
